## CEO BRIEFING

At 11:42 UTC, we began experiencing elevated error rates (502 responses) specifically on the Batch API. The issue was confined to one of our two worker fleets (fleet-a).

We applied a mitigation at 12:58 by moving all Batch API traffic to the healthy fleet (fleet-b). Since the cutover, error rates have dropped significantly and are currently holding at approximately 0.3%.

The root cause is not yet established. We are investigating two main hypotheses: a recent change to database connection pool settings in the latest release, or concentrated load on the affected fleet. We have not yet performed a rollback test to confirm.

The incident is currently in a verification window that ends at 14:30 UTC. We are also re-driving failed jobs for affected accounts; roughly 60% have been processed so far with no further failures.

Impact: Seven customer accounts were affected by the failures on fleet-a. Contoso is the only affected customer with an SLA that carries service credits.

For your 15:00 board call: The service is mitigated and recovering, but we are still in the monitoring phase to confirm full stability.

## ENGINEERING UPDATE

**Status:** Mitigated. Verification window open until 14:30.

**Current State:**
- All Batch API traffic has been cut over to fleet-b (completed 12:58).
- fleet-a is drained and out of rotation.
- Error rate on `POST /v1/batch/jobs` is holding at 0.3% (baseline 0.2%).
- Re-drive of failed jobs is ~60% complete; no failures observed on re-drive.

**Unresolved Items:**
- Root cause not established.
- `r3` rollback test has not been run.
- fleet-a has not been returned to service.

**Hypotheses:**
- **H1 (Leading):** Connection-pool change in `r3` (max pool size 80 -> 24). Workers on fleet-a were observed queueing on DB connections. Note: `r3` is also on fleet-b and that fleet is healthy.
- **H2 (Secondary):** Concentrated load on fleet-a. Volume was ~3x morning average due to a large scheduled job from wonka-industries.

**Next Steps:**
- Complete verification window (14:30).
- Finish job re-drive.
- Determine if/when to run rollback test on fleet-a to isolate H1 vs H2.

## CUSTOMER EMAIL

Subject: Update regarding Batch API errors

Dear Contoso,

We are currently investigating an incident affecting the Batch API, which began at 11:42 UTC today.

A mitigation has been applied and the service is recovering. We are currently monitoring the API to ensure stability before confirming full recovery. We will provide a further update by 15:30 UTC.

Regarding your inquiry about service credits, we will determine the final Monthly Availability for the Batch API after the end of the calendar month, as per the terms in Schedule B of your Master Services Agreement. We will publish the official figures within 10 business days of the month's end, at which point you may submit a claim.

Our records for your account during the incident window (11:42 to 12:58 UTC) show:
- Total Batch API requests: 9,400
- Failed Batch API requests: 3,410

We apologize for the disruption.

## STATUS PAGE UPDATE

We have applied a mitigation to the Batch API and the service is recovering. We are currently monitoring the API to ensure stability before confirming full recovery. We will provide a further update by 15:30 UTC.

*Monitoring.*
